info.title: Keeper API
info.description: API spec for Tacito Square Keeper component, managing agent configurations, communities, and support entities.

tags.name: agent-config/llm-bindings
tags.description: Bounded context: Agent Configuration · Model Bindings. Manages LLM provider registrations used by agents at runtime.

tags.name: agent-config/mcp-servers
tags.description: Bounded context: Agent Configuration · Tool Bindings. Manages MCP server profiles that expose tools to agents.

tags.name: agent-config/skills
tags.description: Bounded context: Agent Configuration · Skills. Defines skill collections and controls which tools an agent may use.

tags.name: agent-config/prompt-engineering
tags.description: Bounded context: Agent Configuration · Prompt Engineering. Manages versioned prompt templates and the collections that group them.

tags.name: agent-config/agents
tags.description: Bounded context: Agent Configuration · Templates. Manages agent templates used to deploy autonomous units at runtime.
